Tesseract.js Core 7.0.0 — WebAssembly third-party notices

The tesseract.js-core 7.0.0 WebAssembly build includes the following upstream
submodules. The revisions below are the gitlink commits pinned by the exact
npm source commit acffef2b66eb44a31df297e11d905f4b39001068. The accompanying
files preserve the license/copyright text from those pinned revisions.
